_doc: Fixed before any data is generated. Name pairs are [negative-side name, positive-side name]. A1 trains on 'kev_seen' + 'a1_train' polar pairs and on fresh random 5-letter strings (never the 'random_test' ones). 'heldout' pairs and style S3 never appear in training. Neutral pairs avoid A/B so they cannot collide with the Qwen readout's answer letters.
